intro: Knorr-Bremse is the global market leader for braking systems and a leading supplier of other safety-critical rail and commercial vehicle systems. Over 33,000 employees in more than 30 countries develop, manufacture, and service braking, door, HVAC, and control systems.
vision: We want to be the recognized global technology leader for the safest and most efficient mobility on rail and road.
